about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2019-09-17 election, from the day after the previous election (2019-04-09) to the day before the vote, newest first: 68 polls by 13 pollsters (4 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2019-05-30 (66 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/, with the same lists, blocs, agreements and result as data/2019-09.json; parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: Netanyahu bloc as Wikipedia's 'Gov.' column and calibration.json count it: Likud, Shas, UTJ, Yamina. Yisrael Beiteinu (Lieberman, in neither bloc) is 'mid'. Otzma Yehudit is right-wing but outside the counted bloc; it is marked 'mid' so the bloc figures match calibration.json (it failed, so the result bloc totals do not depend on this).
